title: Phase closeout
canonical_definition: Reconcile the accumulated matching-market graph, run the required Level 3 qualification, preserve durable evidence, and prepare the handoff to CMP-3 — node420 worker runtime.
authority_boundaries: worker offers and compute requests advertise terms but do not grant custody, settlement or execution authority
accepted request/offer/provider/resource/beneficiary/pricing commitments are immutable historical state
CMP-1.3 WorkerSnapshot/capacity controller remains the sole capacity reservation authority
pricing is deterministic integer-only and bounded by requester ceilings and published offer terms
failed or stale market operations remain failure-atomic

ci_ownership.solidity_full_inventory: Solidity Contracts / four balanced PR shards
ci_ownership.genesis_address_authority: Genesis Address Authority / no duplicate full Foundry

non_applicable_direct_clients.420-rpc: no CMP-2 source/config/API surface changed or direct matching-market consumer introduced
non_applicable_direct_clients.Search: no CMP-2 direct consumer surface changed or introduced
non_applicable_direct_clients.frontend/backend: no CMP-2 user-facing application or service implementation exists in this phase

live_blockers: public testnet deployment and funded-chain market evidence remain CMP-9 scope
real worker runtime remains CMP-3 scope
ProtocolRegistry publication/deployed runtime evidence is not fabricated by repository closeout
